project.name: Wester Denoon
project.boundarySource: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Catalogue-addition settlement gate. Nearby castles, Pictish stones and other attractions do not inflate the settlement score. Score corrected after removal of the artificial sub-60 catalogue gate. Settlement merit was assessed before applying the map threshold; standalone attractions were not transferred into the town score. Angus-wide full audit completed 2026-09-01: all six visitor categories, the four named commercial trail providers, current official/conventional routes, strict-boundary scoring and local HES/NRHE integrity were checked.

features.fullDescription: Dated 1711. Single chamber, rectangular-plan lectern dovecot. Coursed and random rubble with moulded ashlar doorway. Stepped rat course/alighting ledge. Centre door to S with lintel inscribed 17-JB-KO-11. Lined with stone nesting boxes. Roofless.
